model: roster_players rows are SEASON ROSTER OBSERVATIONS of a programme (random id per row); there is no global player/person identity column or table (players = Thriv3 athletes, not roster players)

writers.refresh classifier (integrity:refresh): identity scoped to programme + season; same name twice on a page -> IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS; same name on another programme that season -> review; name-format variant of a held row -> IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS (8B.1); transfer -> NEW row + TRANSFER CANDIDATE note, never linked; absence -> NOT_OBSERVED_CURRENT_SEASON (8B.1), never deleted
writers.projectRosterMinutes.js prior_programme: NAME-ONLY national link: a 2026 row gets prior_programme = the programme of the unique same-normalised-name 2025 row anywhere (skips names on >1 programme). UNSAFE — see measure
writers.projectRosterMinutes.js projected_minute: same programme + normalised name carry-forward (programme-scoped; a same-name teammate collision is possible but bounded to one roster)

decision: Safe hierarchy: (1) same programme + season + name = the same player-season observation; (2) same programme, next season, same name + class progressing = CONTINUATION note (new row); (3) another programme = TRANSFER CANDIDATE only, linked by nobody without corroboration (hometown + class/eligibility continuity + review). Broad roster promotion is BLOCKED until prior_programme requires corroboration (it is the one place a name alone establishes cross-programme identity).
